annotations.title: See an example AI visibility card

description: Shows what Proofsource measures, without signing in: a real visibility card for one example brand (Tesla), from answers collected from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews. It shows how often AI answers mention the brand, per engine, which competitors they name instead, and sample answers. Use it when someone asks whether their brand shows up in AI answers and has not signed in. It always shows the example brand; to check their own brand they sign in.

brand.description: Optional: the brand the person asked about. The example card is shown either way, with a note to sign in to check that brand.
